messages.subject: "Failed to merge output from incompatible analysis."
parts:
Hello all,

Successfully processed data from one time point. Tried to run exactly the same script for another time point, changing only the location of the CSV files but I keep receiving the following error... 

Report part 2
 1 2 3 Error: Failed to merge output from incompatible analysis. Please
                    make sure you use a consistent set of parameters within a single analysis.Error in matrix(" ", 1, (ncol(SUMMARY) - ncol(SUM$summary))) : 
  invalid 'ncol' value (< 0)


The files were converted to CSV in exactly the same way and the script is unchanged - see below

library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
  datadir= "E:/GGIR/SUMMERALL/CSVSUMMER", 
  outputdir= "E:/GGIR/SUMMERALL/OUTPUT_SUMMER",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),
  #------------------------------- 
  # Part 1 parameters:
  #-------------------------------
  windowsizes = c(5,900,3600), 
  do.cal=TRUE, 
  do.enmo = TRUE, 
  do.anglez=TRUE, 
  chunksize=1,
  printsummary=TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
  M5L5res = 10,
  winhr = c(5,10),
  qlevels = c(c(1380/1440),c(1410/1440)), 
  qwindow=c(7,9,16,18,22), 
  ilevels = c(0,50,200,700,8000), 
  mvpathreshold =c(200),
  bout.metric = 4,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE, 
  includenightcrit = 16, 
  iglevels = c(seq(0,4000,by=25),8000),
   #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = FALSE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(50), threshold.mod = c(200),  threshold.vig = c(700),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)


As the error message reads "1 2 3 Error:" I thought there might be an issue with the 3rd or 4th file? I removed both files and ran the script again but the same error message appeared.

I'm now re-converting the CSV files to see if this makes any difference.

Does anyone understand the error message or have any advice please?

Many thanks,
Owen.

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: "Failed to merge output from incompatible analysis."
parts:
How about using different outputdir for the two datasets? That should avoid any analysis compatibility issues.
When you encounter error message it may also help to temporarilly set g.shell.GGIR argument do.parallel = FALSE, which will turn off the parallel processing functionality and allows you to focus on error messages file by file.
Vincent
